content.short: Semgrep provides rules for Solidity smart contracts based on DeFi exploits.
content.description: Semgrep is a community-curated collection of Semgrep rules focused on Solidity smart contracts. Maintained by ethical hackers working on real-world DeFi security, the repository continually expands with rules designed to detect common vulnerabilities and risky patterns in Solidity code. Developers can scan their contracts, run CLI-based tests, and validate code against known rules to improve security before deployment. It's open-source and suitable for integration into CI workflows.

resources.title: Pattern Matching for Vulnerabilities
resources.tldr: Rules written in YAML that catch protocol-specific bugs a generic analyser misses. Not a replacement for Slither, and says so.

resources.title: Rules Derived From Real Exploits
resources.tldr: Each rule paired with the vulnerable code an attacker actually hit, so the pattern is validated rather than theoretical.
